name: Charge Boots
author: Henning Berge
description: Going Commando's Charge Boots in Ratchet & Clank: double-tap R1 and hold to charge along his facing, steering with the stick; enemies in the way are hit, a wall bonks him back. Takes over the Thruster-Pack's hover. Owned with the Persuader (Fred on Pokitaru), or from the start. Needs OpenRAC with the rac1.player.steer_planar_velocity hook point.

settings.name: Speed
settings.description: Times Going Commando's charge speeds (11.5 units a second, 30 in the first second).
